env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env SRC=$PWD
[!exec:sed] skip 'needs sed to edit the facts'
[!exec:sh] skip 'needs sh to extend the import config'

# A composite record whose path does not match the variable's type is rejected.
go list -export -deps -f '{{if .Export}}packagefile {{.ImportPath}}={{.Export}}{{end}}' fmt logos/rt
cp stdout $WORK/cfg.base
go tool compile -p example.com/forge/lib -importcfg $WORK/cfg.base -o $WORK/lib.a lib/lib.lgo
go tool pack p $WORK/lib.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^constcomp C$'
stdout '^constmap C [0-9]+ \.M$'
cp stdout $WORK/facts.orig
exec sh -c 'cat $WORK/cfg.base > $WORK/cfg.ok; echo packagefile example.com/forge/lib=$WORK/lib.a >> $WORK/cfg.ok'
go tool compile -p main -importcfg $WORK/cfg.ok -o $WORK/ok.a app/main.lgo

mkdir $WORK/m1
cd $WORK/m1
go tool pack x $WORK/lib.a
cd $SRC
exec sed 's/^\(constmap C [0-9]* \)\.M$/\1.N/' $WORK/facts.orig
rm $WORK/m1/__.LOGOS
cp stdout $WORK/m1/__.LOGOS
cd $WORK/m1
go tool pack c $WORK/bad1.a __.PKGDEF __.LOGOS _go_.o
cd $SRC
go tool pack p $WORK/bad1.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^constmap C [0-9]+ \.N$'
exec sh -c 'cat $WORK/cfg.base > $WORK/cfg.bad1; echo packagefile example.com/forge/lib=$WORK/bad1.a >> $WORK/cfg.bad1'
! go tool compile -p main -importcfg $WORK/cfg.bad1 -o $WORK/bad1.o app/main.lgo
stdout 'app/main\.lgo:10:14: .*example\.com/forge/lib\.C\.N'
! stdout 'internal compiler error'

mkdir $WORK/m2
cd $WORK/m2
go tool pack x $WORK/lib.a
cd $SRC
exec sed 's/^\(constmap C [0-9]* \)\.M$/\1.M[0]/' $WORK/facts.orig
rm $WORK/m2/__.LOGOS
cp stdout $WORK/m2/__.LOGOS
cd $WORK/m2
go tool pack c $WORK/bad2.a __.PKGDEF __.LOGOS _go_.o
cd $SRC
exec sh -c 'cat $WORK/cfg.base > $WORK/cfg.bad2; echo packagefile example.com/forge/lib=$WORK/bad2.a >> $WORK/cfg.bad2'
! go tool compile -p main -importcfg $WORK/cfg.bad2 -o $WORK/bad2.o app/main.lgo
stdout 'app/main\.lgo:10:14: .*example\.com/forge/lib\.C\.M\[0\]'
! stdout 'internal compiler error'

-- lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type S struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

const C = S{M: map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2}, N: 7}

-- app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/forge/lib"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(lib.C.M["a"] ?? -1)
}
